programme.title: 非夢奇緣
programme.desc: 李子雲遭伙記阿讒襲擊搶去財物，因而失憶，幸得婢女蕭月梅救濟並結成夫婦，婚後更育有一女。雲出外打工意外受傷，恢復記憶卻忘記妻女，梅母女遂尋雲至李家，雲拒相認，梅傷心不已。雲舊地重遊勾起記憶，終一家團聚。

programme.title: 密底算盤
programme.desc: 江英因應付其妹醫藥費，租住董慧貞較便宜的房間，與常明和白水為鄰，二人皆鍾情英。古大昌透過貞認識英，一見傾心。英妹要錢動手術，昌乘借錢之機逼英下嫁。貞喜歡昌不惜代英還錢，更助明追求英。貞終與昌共諧連理。

programme.title: 鐵馬神龍
programme.desc: 胡人入侵馬家村，馬明章之父被賣國土豪彭冬發手下打死，章被逐出村。章妻林淑英為生計當發女小碧的乳娘，與章分離。多年後，章派兩名兒子往馬家村打探，兩子被擒。英與碧幫忙救人，碧最終更化解了彭、馬兩家的仇怨。

programme.title: 遺產一百萬
programme.desc: 富商李劍華留下大筆遺產，家族各人各懷鬼胎。戴律師根據遺囑，按照血統親疏將遺產交給華的親人，誰料合資格的遺產繼承人相繼被殺，而何若蘭成為兇手的下一目標，其新相識的朋友程子森趕往營救，最終揭發事情的真相。

programme.title: 瘋婦
programme.desc: 錢萬頃因迷信令四代同堂的好夢落空，更導致孫媳李若梅不育，把她趕走。時盛傳瘋婦鬼魂出沒，趙仁夫婦為奪頃家產，假扮瘋婦殺人嫁禍梅。鄉紳得悉梅是瘋婦之女，欲把她燒死，幸有證人指證真兇，梅與母、信另闢新生活。

programme.title: 愛封了普
programme.desc: 電影講述了一名性格直爽的重慶女孩玲兒因偶然相識愛上了一個生活在德國的男人,雖然遠隔重洋但始終保持電話聯絡隨後,玲兒用在花店打工的薪水隻身前往德國找尋屬於自己的愛情女孩在衝破迷惘固執看清愛人的真實嘴臉

programme.title: 幽靈情書粵普
programme.desc: 倫一直暗戀中學同學小月,在那年暑假後,她失蹤了倫在營火會無意中見到一女子飄過,令他再想起小月自此倫鬱鬱不歡其好友史和華知其心意,決助倫尋找小月下落終找到小月好友Fanny

programme.title: 生日快樂粵普
programme.desc: 每年的生日,小米(劉若英飾)都坐立不安的等待著一封風雨不改的電郵,一封從小南(古天樂飾),一個她從來無法忘記的人寄來的生日電郵這次,滂沱大雨之下,這封電郵遲了42個小時

programme.title: 辣手神探粵普
programme.desc: 袁浩雲(周潤發飾)是個作風剛烈的神探江浪(梁朝偉飾)是一名臥底,他混入集團成為頭目海叔的左右手就在一次警方追查軍火交易的行動中,袁與江相遇,並洞悉其臥底身份,遂力邀他一同殲滅Johnny的犯罪集團

programme.title: 情聖粵
programme.desc: 程勝(周星馳)本是騙子一名,為人機靈熱心,極受女孩歡迎他與女騙徒葉圓(毛舜筠)相遇,程勝被誤作為盲人,程勝乃予以訛騙後因見葉圓被追債,挺身相助,而為她負了一身債nn老江湖周潤發(午馬)因欠下貴利王(張耀揚)債,被逼去向一富豪詐騙偶然下周潤發認定程勝就是該富豪,程勝乃將計就計反騙周潤發最後大家卻發現各人都欠下貴利王巨債,乃合力對抗貴利王

programme.title: 大隻佬粵
programme.desc: 身材壯碩武藝超凡的武僧大隻佬(劉德華飾)在逃離探員李鳳儀(張栢芝飾)的追捕期間,遇上警犬,同時在警犬身後見到小童追打狗隻的影像,警犬隨即被追捕歹徒的警員誤射死亡大隻佬首次展現他看到因果的能力,接着,又在李身後看到日軍屠殺平民的影像nn大隻佬見李鳳儀生性善良,決定幫助李查一宗兇殺案,但誓言破案後,兩人便如同陌路大隻佬在房中查看過屍首後,再次展現能看到過去的能力,稱之為「看到因果」死者過

programme.title: 監獄風雲粵
programme.desc: 盧家耀(梁家輝飾)是一名美術設計師,年輕有為,有良好的教育及家庭背景;但是天有不測之風雲,盧父的店舖遭滋事分子滋擾,家耀因幫助父親與滋事分子大打出手,混亂中錯手殺人,被判誤殺罪入獄3年nn對於盧家耀來說,獄中的生活簡直是另一個世界且難以適應,而且他為人耿直,不自覺地得罪了獄中的大哥,受盡苦辱委屈,幸好得到見義勇為的鍾天正(周潤發飾)提點幫助,兩人結為患難知己nn監獄的生活暗無天日,監獄內

programme.title: 城市獵人粵
programme.desc: 孟波(成龍飾),綽號「城市獵人」,是一位私家偵探過去曾有一位搭檔中村(王敏德客串),然而中村在一次單獨出任務時失手,臨死前將妹妹惠香(王祖賢飾)託付給孟波,並囑咐孟波不可以泡她長大以後的惠香卻遠超過孟波當初的認知,讓孟波很後悔當初答應中村不泡惠香;惠香成為孟波的助手,兩人的關係相當曖昧nn日本報業大王今村宏次(荻原賢三飾)的獨生女今村清子(後藤久美子飾)離家出走,今村宏次得知女兒去了香

programme.title: 算死草粵普
programme.desc: 清代名咀大狀陳夢吉到香港接辦一宗棘手殺人冤案,在洋人大法官面前扭盡六壬,死都拗番生,以過人才智挑戰西方法理和玩死貪官污吏

programme.title: 海角七號普
programme.desc: 1945年二次世界大戰結束,一位日本籍教師在遣返船上寫下給他臺灣籍女學生兼愛人小島友子的七封情書但隨著兩人分離兩地另組家庭,成了寄不出去的第七封情書六十餘年後的現代,原於臺北任樂團主唱的阿嘉,打滾十餘年仍一事無成,一日早晨失意地騎著的摩托車,由臺北騎回故鄉屏東縣恆春鎮,並在鎮民代表會主席的關說與安排下暫時接替因為車禍而無法工作的老郵差茂伯之工作,其中有一件來自日本,要寄到海角七號的郵包

programme.title: 孤男寡女粵
programme.desc: 華少 (劉德華飾)是一家電腦零件銷售公司的部門經理,他風流花心並有過一段婚史,其名聲在一些女同事口中並不好KINKI (鄭秀文飾)是華少屬下的一名新員工,她對愛情很是看重,並在傷心時會有神經質般的表現,近日她發現男友跟其他女子有染,於是在公司裏瘋鬧了一場並準備辭職,在購物時還將物品一一弄丟而華少在公司裏與一名競爭對手Martin有矛盾,幸得到KINKI的援助得以化解,使華少對她很有好感,

programme.title: 替身紙人

programme.title: Circle of Bones

programme.title: Chop Chop

programme.title: 看不見的他們
programme.desc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck

programme.title: 密室逃生

programme.title: 大軍閥

programme.title: 奪棍
programme.desc: 一天,絕代棍王紅鷹被惡霸擄走,徒弟阿檬誓要救出師父。途中,阿檬遇上雖貪財,卻武功了得的朱頭炳。在阿檬的利誘下,朱頭炳決定一同出發營救紅鷹。即使二人南轅北轍,但最終仍合力與惡霸終極一戰。

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘,裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人,陰差陽錯間,孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂,劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配,讓成誤會,終鬧上公堂,喬太守將錯就錯,乾脆來了一個亂點,結果正好有情人終成眷屬,皆大歡喜。

programme.title: 洪熙官
programme.desc: 清廷走狗白眉道人焚毀少林寺後,繼續追捕殘存的少林弟子。洪熙官在逃亡期間遇見了方詠春,兩人墜入愛河結為夫婦,並育有一子名為文定。洪熙官最終被白眉所殺,文定決心融合父母遺留下的武藝,創立虎鶴雙形拳,以報父仇。

programme.title: 傾國傾城
programme.desc: 李翰祥史詩式電影,藝術成就及導演功力震驚中港台三地。本片榮獲金馬優等劇情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美術設計獎項。影后盧燕飾慈禧太后;處女演出即成名的蕭瑤,飾死後受追封為貴妃的珍妃;而為珍妃逝世而不近女色的光緒帝則是狄龍。

programme.title: 死囚
programme.desc: 流浪漢馮大剛被誤指為劫匪,遭逮捕後關押於死囚牢。真正的劫匪為了滅口,賄賂獄中扒手楊靈對馮大剛下毒手。楊靈明白馮大剛是冤枉的,於是暗中設法幫助他逃獄。誰料逃獄計劃意外失敗,最終兩人反而成為真正的死囚。

programme.title: 人蛇鼠
programme.desc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來,接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結,圖取莊家產業,並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德!怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下,反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠,欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死,「西西」為救嬰兒,與野鼠作殊死搏鬥

programme.title: 瘋猴
programme.desc: 陳百精通「猴拳」,但卻被惡霸設計陷害,更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人,直到遇上街頭小子小侯,決將一身「猴拳」,傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手,勢要一雪前恥。

programme.title: 徐老虎與白寡婦
programme.desc: 本片改編自高陽同名著作,獲第18屆金馬獎最佳服裝設計、最佳美術設計兩項獎。本片講述清朝食鹽私梟徐老虎與白寡婦因清官李振彪拒不受賄,再加上責令嚴緝私鹽,二人面臨緝案危機。為免同僚落網,白獨擔罪責。徐悉白被處死,一心復仇…

programme.title: 水晶人
programme.desc: 故事講述,龍飛精心雕琢的水晶美人像忽然失蹤後,多名黑道高手離奇被殺,江湖傳言乃水晶人變成精靈殺人之所為。龍飛經過連番追蹤後,終發現水晶人乃日後訓練之殺手。水晶人揭發江湖廝殺之真正幕後人,實為偽裝王爺的天帝

programme.title: 七仙女
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家,為奴以埋父骨;其孝心感動了七仙女,便幻成村姑,在六位仙姐下凡暗助下,為董縮減償還工作日,回復自由後,二人回董故家,但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢?

programme.title: 小煞星
programme.desc: 強宜本是夜總會歌星,後來為尋初戀女友水仙的下落,被人帶到匪幫的木屋。原來,強宜少年時誤入歧途,有打劫殺人的犯罪紀錄,綽號「小煞星」。一哥要脅他共同打劫珠寶行,否則公開他的秘密。強宜假意應承,從長計議。想不到當日行動踏入珠寶行,發現售貨員竟然是初戀女友水仙!

programme.title: 港澳傳奇
programme.desc: 澳門古玩店老闆,識破老婆與估衣鋪老闆有染後,威脅胡幫他引誘垂涎已久的王妻;香港賭徒在澳賭場邂逅流黑市夫人,事後恬要求與石同居,結局出人意表

programme.title: 武館
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛,得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄,從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品,更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。

programme.title: 武館
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛,得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄,從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品,更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。

programme.title: 流氓千王
programme.desc: 宗華與李修賢飾賭術精湛的流氓千王,李在澳門賭場被陳萍飾的千后擊倒後,遂回港與宗合作一雪其恥,出千騙財,開設豪華賭場,欲將陳誘得入局…

programme.title: 夕陽戀人
programme.desc: 這是日本導演上梅次文藝片的經典。故事描述井莉飾的車衣女工與秦沛飾的修車工,在夕陽萌生感情,後女因識破男的太子爺身份,深感受騙

programme.title: 方世玉與胡惠乾
programme.desc: 武當派敗類白眉道人、馮道德、雷老虎等,勾結清廷,甘受驅使來殘殺武林中人,方世玉之父母方濟亨、苗翠花,胡惠乾之父皆為雷等所殺;胡一次尋仇不遂,為方所救,後隨方往少林寺練就高強武功影片最後少林與武當之武林自相殘殺的畫面,出現一幕令人怵目驚心的大結局。

programme.title: 花街時代
programme.desc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女,自此淪落風塵。其後,美麗在酒吧認識占美,深深愛上他,並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候,傷心的美麗即陷入低潮,直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。

programme.title: 飛刀手
programme.desc: 綽號飛刀追魂的焦雷與乾坤劍名手于遠結怨,焦要追殺于全家。幸得飛刀手楊青救了于的女兒于英;但楊青生性風流,向于英開出對付焦雷的條件是共渡一夜。于英憎惡他,又不得不和他一起助父親與焦雷決鬥。相處日久,于英才明白楊非登徒浪子,實對她深愛非常。

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: 年輕書生寧采臣在傳說鬧鬼的恐怖寺廟裡過夜。雖然他不相信傳聞,卻遇上美麗的女鬼聶小倩。原來聶小倩被困在寺廟中,誘使年輕男子給魔頭姥姥享用。寧采臣得悉聶小倩為一隻善良的女鬼,於是決定助她逃離魔掌。

programme.title: 大盜歌王
programme.desc: 一名珠寶神偷棄邪歸正,搖身一變成為夜總會歌手。發生連串搶劫案後,他馬上又成為嫌疑犯。於是,神偷設計捉拿冒認者,最終會否連累自己?

programme.title: 藍與黑
programme.desc: 抗日戰爭期間,少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦,不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路

programme.title: 南斗官三鬥北少爺
programme.desc: 廣東大良富家子弟南斗官天資聰穎、武藝高強,卻屢次惹禍生事,母親遂命他上京招親,藉此磨練心性。途中,他結識了精通千術的車載、追女高手真厲害及身懷絕技的神偷時三手,四人不打不相識,隨後攜手對抗圖謀南家家產的三眼道人。

programme.title: 北地胭脂
programme.desc: 本片由三個發生在妓院「百花樓」的單元故事組成。〈花街柳巷〉講述妓女大琴不甘淪落為娼,竟冒險向巡官告狀,要求救她脫離火坑;〈滿宮春色〉講述同治皇帝大婚之前,往妓院尋歡,終於染上梅毒不治;〈游龍豔史〉講述正德皇帝與名妓佛動心同入鴛帳

programme.title: 卒仔抽車
programme.desc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子,遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成,達成了一個賭局,要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力,終戰勝億萬富豪!

programme.title: 我愛金龜婿
programme.desc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。

programme.title: 大決鬥
programme.desc: 得知弟弟殺死黑社會頭目後,唐人杰毅然承擔罪責,成為殺手追殺的目標。在江南浪子的協助下,他終於成功復仇,卻驚覺江南浪子正是殺害父親的真兇。

programme.title: 五遁忍術
programme.desc: 東瀛武士挑戰武林盟主袁增,戰敗後切腹自盡。忍者之王劍淵率領忍者渡海復仇,並佈下威力驚人的「五遁忍術」奇陣。袁增門下高手不諳忍術詭計,貿然迎戰竟全軍覆沒。倖存弟子潛心鑽研五遁之法,誓要以其人之道還治其人之身,破陣雪恥。

programme.title: 五遁忍術
programme.desc: 東瀛武士挑戰武林盟主袁增,戰敗後切腹自盡。忍者之王劍淵率領忍者渡海復仇,並佈下威力驚人的「五遁忍術」奇陣。袁增門下高手不諳忍術詭計,貿然迎戰竟全軍覆沒。倖存弟子潛心鑽研五遁之法,誓要以其人之道還治其人之身,破陣雪恥。

programme.title: 女校春色
programme.desc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。

programme.title: 大旗英雄傳
programme.desc: 鐵中棠是大旗門掌門人雲翼的義子。門派宿敵司徒笑為奪取秘藏,追殺鐵中棠與雲翼次子雲錚。鐵中棠得知,唯有前往長春島尋找武功蓋世的「日后」,才能揭開大旗門的秘密。然而抵達後卻發現「日后」早已身亡,反而遇見大旗門創始人「夜帝」鐵毅,並驚覺對方竟是自己的親生父親。

programme.title: 西廂記
programme.desc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會,俏紅娘從中牽赤繩;西廂夜訪,私定終身;崔老夫人知情大怒,憤而拷紅;紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信,終成就百年姻緣。

programme.title: 決殺令
programme.desc: 百毒派銳意製造武林不和,以實現稱霸江湖的野心。他們派出蒙面刺客殺戮另一門派,但其中一名刺客被捕後即被其他門派公審。最後審訊結果是什麼?最終又能否揭開真相?

programme.title: 武則天
programme.desc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。

programme.title: 陰陽刀
programme.desc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年,他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死,為他們報仇雪恨!惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎?

programme.title: 八國聯軍
programme.desc: 清朝末年政局腐敗,社會民不聊生,慈禧太后與一群愚昧無知的權貴大臣不但毫無抵禦外國列強侵佔,以及保護人民的能力,反而迷信以吞符唸咒,自稱無堅不摧的「義和團」可以抵禦洋人,決意向列強宣戰。結果導致八國聯軍攻陷北京,慈禧太后倉惶逃難;人民這才醒悟到,只有孫中山先生領導的革命运動,才是挽救中國的唯一希望。

programme.title: 鬼馬兩金剛
programme.desc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天,他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢,途中卻遇上革命戰士,並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士?

programme.title: 降頭
programme.desc: 狄龍劇中為一準新郎,但卻遇上心術不正的恬妮單戀癡纏,更借助邪術降頭,務求奪取男方歡心。後恬妮裙下之臣羅烈及狄龍未婚妻,亦相繼加入戰團。一場因為愛而生與死的鬥爭,複雜的關係加上正邪大鬥法,將人性為達一己私慾的惡行,表露無遺。至於邪是否不能勝正?且看結局便有分曉。

programme.title: 踩綫
programme.desc: 本片由著名演員王鍾編導,為 1981年的社會寫實電影。故事描述,呂良偉與李修賢在片中均為中越混血兒, 由越南逃至澳門;呂於香港出生,可在港居留,乃與李分散;鄭則仕飾呂之叔父,為一幹練警探,即介紹呂加入員警世界,派其作臥底。後鄭一次與越南匪徒糾鬥中 遭殺害;而李則被牽涉入這宗凶案

programme.title: 魔界
programme.desc: 故事講述,警局偵緝部情侶探員鄭忠與王麗芬同往離島露營,半夜麗芬忽聞異聲,離營探看,突見綠光一閃,隨即著魔。翌日,王警官率眾處理一宗挾持人質案件,期間麗芬逕自開槍射殺劫匪,過程被雜誌記者阿古攝得,發現子彈竟能轉向殺人

programme.title: 血鸚鵡
programme.desc: 據說諸魔化成的血鸚鵡,看見它的人能得到三個願望。江湖俠盜葉停楓為追尋血鸚鵡的真相;與名捕「鐵手無情」鐵恨聯手。某夜,葉、鐵二人在墳場遇上血鸚鵡,鐵死於它的魔力之下;後葉將其屍體送回家鄉安葬。其後,屍體卻離奇失蹤,葉經歷重重險阻後,終於見到真正的血鸚鵡…

programme.title: 大俠沈勝衣
programme.desc: 武林中人對白家珍藏的「唐門火冊」虎視眈眈,後更揚言要擄劫其女。大俠沈勝衣於是建議以其情人煙飛代白家小姐,並尋出個中玄機

programme.title: 出租女俠
programme.desc: 計程車司機栗花,是一個單身母親。他丈夫是一名員警,因為一次車禍去世了。栗花與兒子張明明的母子關係緊張,為了能夠得到兒子的承認,她決定做一名兒子崇拜的超級英雄。她化身出租女俠懲惡揚善,無意中招惹了販賣假藥的邪惡組織。為了得到兒子的承認和自己心

programme.title: 狼兵吼
programme.desc: 該片講述了抗日戰爭全面爆發後,滇軍中的大批文山兒女在抗日前線英勇殺敵,突破日軍的圍追堵截,將文山三七運送到前線為抗日將士止血療傷的故事。

programme.title: 鐵血大動脈
programme.desc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,美國李奇威將軍對我志願軍實施剿殺戰略,對我軍公路、鐵路運輸線展開狂轟亂炸。彭總司令委任梁軍英擔任交通運輸總司令。梁司令與廣大幹部戰士群策群力,以自己的血肉之軀扛起了我軍的生命線。

programme.title: 向日葵中隊
programme.desc: “向日葵中隊孩子在米蘭老師關懷下,接納和幫助轉學生莫離,她是“星星的孩子〞。在找同桌、護小花、學跳繩、公開課、十點之約等故事裡,莫離漸漸走出孤獨,融入溫暖集體,同學們也學會以愛擁抱生活,向陽生長。

programme.title: 「蟲」林的法則 #1
programme.desc: 一旦天氣變冷變黑,昆蟲開始從草地和田地消失,牠們會慢慢消失直至全滅所有動物都有其特殊的生存方式,像燕子和鶴這種候鳥會飛向南方,許多像鹿一樣的哺乳動物會得到厚厚的冬季皮毛或躲在溫暖的地方冬眠但昆蟲都做了甚麼?為何牠們在春天就會回歸?

programme.title: 「蟲」林的法則 #2
programme.desc: 太恐怖了!這是謀殺!殘酷的死亡以及刺激的戰鬥,還有特殊的絕地救援你在看到它之後就會知道最令人毛骨悚然的地方其實就是你附近的草叢利用來自恐怖類型的型格設備,這部非凡的自然紀錄片將帶您跟隨一位著名英雄,牠有六條腿,紅色的翅膀和七個黑點,這趟旅程的目的地是一個看似正常但充滿怪物的草叢

programme.title: 動物解碼 #1 英普
programme.desc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼

programme.title: 不羈尚比亞 #3 英普
programme.desc: 隨著旱季開始,成千上萬的動物正前往相思環每頭動物都必須在捕食順序中確立自己的位置,避免那些非常願意以粗心的動物作大餐的危險居民

programme.title: 不羈尚比亞 #4 英普
programme.desc: 毛拉是麥茲家族中最年輕的小牛隨著氣溫飆升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭逼使毛拉和牠的家人進行一次漫長而危險的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源:盧安瓜河

programme.title: 大戰狐?島 #2 英普
programme.desc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的貝倫地保育區,旱季正對當地的環尾狐猴造成巨大的損耗隨著覓食的難度增加,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹之間的關係越發緊張隨著食物和水源日益稀缺,入侵者亦出現在附近

programme.title: 熊寶貝訓練營 #2
programme.desc: 歡迎姐妹檔西巴,西拉和索拉,這三隻挨餓的孤兒讓溫斯頓的世界天翻地覆,直到溫柔的索拉教會溫斯頓友誼的意義然後關注新來的幼熊雅思敏和雅拉,牠們在經歷驚險的分離後重新相聚

programme.desc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件

programme.title: 起司愛旅 #6

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪,歷史和個人之旅

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #2
programme.desc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成

programme.title: 成名之旅 #1
programme.desc: 專訪瑪丹娜第一任經理人卡繆巴龐,舞者卡爾頓威爾邦,艾薇塔工作室執行官羅倫萊等人

programme.title: 成名之旅 #2
programme.desc: 專訪與羅賓威廉斯在《暴雨驕陽》聯合主演的基爾漢臣,《外星驕客》編劇大衛米施,好友兼喜劇演員域克奧華頓等人

programme.title: 神鬼獵人
programme.desc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事

programme.title: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
programme.desc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮

programme.title: 拳王阿里
programme.desc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌他的名字依舊令人尊敬聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生

programme.title: 凱特溫斯蕾:天生女主角
programme.desc: 因《鐵達尼號》而聞名的奧斯卡得主琦溫斯莉因在好萊塢猛片和獨立電影中多變而激烈的演技而受讚譽,使她穩佔同代最優秀演員一席位

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 2 #1
programme.desc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水

programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring fieldDr Matt has been called in to lend a hand The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes Matt decides to return another day

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: Shockwave
programme.desc: On a hot August evening in the Lebanese capital of Beirut, a catastrophic explosion ripped through the city It looked like a scene from a disaster movie, but it was real As the shocking event unfolded, people around the city captured the moment, and its aftermath, on their phones These videos soon went viral This documentary tells the stories of many of those who filmed the blast as well as survivors whose experiences in the moment were dramatically captured onscreen From a bride posing for her wedding photos when the explosion erupted, to divers at sea struck by the blast wave, to the young doctor tending to a woman in labour as the windows exploded inwards, each has an extraordinary story of survival

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: While many mainline Christian churches are in decline, Evangelical Christianity remains a powerful force in the 21st century With 21 billion followers worldwide, this particular branch of faith must be doing something right In this program, host Tevya enters the world of Evangelicals, meeting a local pastor whose weekly service is broadcast to five different locations and features a full rockband He learns that it is all about giving back

programme.title: Trapped in the Volcano
programme.desc: The White Island Volcano eruption in December 2019 claimed the lives of 23 people Despite extraordinary stories of heroism in the rescue effort, could more have been done to prevent this awful loss of life? Terrified members of a boat trip to the New Zealand island watched on as a tower of smoke plumed from the mouth of the Volcano It was not until they reached land that they realised the true horror of the situation “Their skin just dripped off them like wax”, recounts a trained first-aider Tour guide Hayden Marshall-Inman, who laid down his own life to stay behind and continue the rescue effort, is remembered fondly by his brother “Hayden would always be the last man standing” As time passes, grief has turned to anger The victims' families are now building a judicial case against Royal Caribbean Cruises, claiming they did “absolutely nothing” to warn of the risks of a deadly eruption

programme.title: The Opium War
programme.desc: Thousands of young people are dying from using drugs in Kachin State, Myanmar When the government is not doing enough to crack down drugs problem, the civilians formed the anti-drugs organization called “Pat Jasan” which means “Stop and Clean the drugs” in local Kachin Language, to eradicate drugs A clash between “Pa Jasan” groups and drugs lords occurred

programme.title: Children of the Noon
programme.desc: Daily routines mark time for the children of Kenya’s Nchiru AIDS orphanage Delving into the minutiae of their burgeoning lives, it is soon clear that amid their cheerful patter, death lurks in the shadows, as they cope with the loss of parents and friends and the exhausting struggle against HIV A beautifully composed film that quietly grips its audience with a moving exploration of coming-of-age in rural Africa and the impact of HIVAIDS

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler

programme.title: Amazing Dog Tales
programme.desc: A “taste challenge” with a doggie-Gelato master, dog treat tasting, the pros-and-cons of raw food for dogs and Buddy the Dog goes through weight training

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Host Tevya goes deep into the woods to explore the spiritual ways of North America's first Aboriginal people- the people of the First Nations While he has seen headdresses, Pow-Wows, sweat lodges and teepees on television, Tevya knows nothing about what First Nations people really believe or what their rituals are After meeting two indigenous teenagers, Tevya experiences this religion firsthand

programme.title: Inside Antifa
programme.desc: They are faceless They are nameless They are feared and hated And they make no apologies Antifa is notorious for their radical and often divisive tactics - but what’s it really like to be a member of this anti-fascist movement? In the weeks surrounding the 2021 Inauguration, a group of Antifa members allowed one filmmaker full and unprecedented access, as they worked to forge the type of society they want to live in

programme.title: Grit
programme.desc: When Dian was six she narrowly escaped a tsunami of boiling mud that completely submerged 16 villages under a moonscape of grit, leaving 60,000 people displaced Lapindo, an Indonesian drilling company, had unleashed a violent, unstoppable flow from the earth's depths, estimated to continue for another decade Shot over six years, GRIT witnesses Dian's transformation in to a politically active teen, as she and her mother take on the perpetrators

programme.title: You’ve Been Trumped Too
programme.desc: Investigative journalist Anthony Baxter travels between the US Presidential race and the Scottish countryside to chronicle the troubling confrontation between Donald Trump and a feisty 92-year-old widow, Molly Forbes, as she refuses to make way for his golf course This shocking insight to a David and goliath battle is a remarkable document of the disconnect between political rhetoric and the lives of ordinary people

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好

programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。n第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔

方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#201粵
programme.desc: 亨與麗拍拖後愛上到處享受人生，又發現養育下一代需花費巨額金錢。亨一心想賺多些錢，為與麗的未來作出準備，更欲為瑜珈中心開設分店。本來，麗對亨的舉動也心存讚賞，但亨因過分投入搵錢大計而冷落麗。

programme.title: 玉樓春#15粵普PG
programme.desc: 玉樓被強盜綁架，少春隻身赴會贖人，用巧計救出玉樓。玉樓求得皇上賜婚。孫遜私下約見少春，被她的言行打動，不再反對婚事。賈逢源模仿孫遜字跡偽造書信，告訴少春是孫遜害死其父。大婚日孫遜喝下少春敬的茶後昏迷。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之綻放 · 鼎級笑容粵
今個夏天食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽購入海參、花膠、蚌乾等食材，令六號投入陷阱！煮出「海參絲豬柳炒翠玉瓜」及「花膠椰菜卷」時間雖短，但準備工夫甚費時，肥媽可有方法縮短？另一邊廂，以快見稱的肥媽竟教「慢煮豬扒」，並強調醬汁才是最重要！

programme.title: 賽馬會智啟潛能學習計劃呈獻：「特」適其適粵
AXA 安盛呈獻 :歲歲無憂粵
programme.desc: 三位「星級」嘉賓黎耀祥、陳自瑤、張馳豪分別代表「樂齡族」、「夾心世代」與「年輕專業人士」，各人受訪細談處於現時的人生階段，對醫療保障的不同需要。究竟大家可如何做到「歲歲無憂」？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 心絞痛揭示心臟健康問題，不但形容胸口出現的「痛」，也可表現為「悶」或「壓着」，其常見原因是冠狀動脈血管收窄或閉塞。心臟科醫生提醒，痛楚或會擴散至身體不同部位，不容忽視。腎科專科醫生指腎功能開始下降時，通常並無明顯症狀，如持續有蛋白尿就是腎臟受損的早期警號！檢查腎病有何指標？醫生細述慢性腎病的高危因素，糖尿病正是其一，而腎病亦有可能影響心血管健康？「睇餸食飯」，李安生示範「薑蓉蔥油帶子蟹肉意粉」。

programme.title: 不老傳說粵
programme.desc: 盧敏儀個性天真活潑，由電視節目主持搖身變為執業大律師，形象與身分縱然大有不同，唯獨一顆赤子之心始終不變。當年敏儀曾為大型節目作高難度表演，精彩場面令人難忘。事隔多年，她依然身手矯健，箇中有何秘訣？她並即席展示日子有功的鍛練絕活。敏儀享受工作，並將事務所視為另一個家。不過，律師終日面對工作壓力，敏儀幸有丈夫相伴驅除煩惱，二人細說恩愛如昔的心得。另外，梓峰、芷菁同往動植物公園，跟可愛動物共享寫意時光。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#5粵PG
programme.desc: 牧師馬拉高出現於優富超市，利亞以為龍豹向拉高洩露了他的行蹤。拉高救炳哥一命而廉價租下拳館開教會。秋水得悉女性生育後或有助醫治敏感症，便着手籌備郭寶與靜雯的婚禮。靜雯被逼與郭寶親吻，卻因此當眾出醜……

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 學校舉行體力測試，小丸子、小玉都肌肉痠痛，誰知痛楚反而令她們創出佳績。準備充足的小杉大發神威，各項目皆有亮眼表現，令大家對他改觀。小杉一嚐成為主角的滋味，但事後很快便遭到淡忘。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 某小學每年都舉辦大型音樂會，幫助學生一展所長，從而建立自信心。該校校長作客「Kids’ Notes」，細談如何身體力行支持學生發展音樂興趣。音樂會特別挑選小一、二學生擔任司儀，而非高班生，可有甚麼原因？校長還會作曲、填詞，為校內音樂男團創作一首結合唱跳、Rap唱的歌曲，歌詞更成功打動家長的心，讓家長明白到怎樣愛錫小朋友。校長認為家長是教導小朋友的榜樣，減少發脾氣、多點同理心，學生也會跟着學得好。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 細蔥仔希望蔥叔叔一起去尋找長蔥俠。隱瞞長蔥俠身份的蔥叔叔，建議他與蜜瓜包妹妹一起去。細菌人為了對付麵包超人，而把被封印了的黑玫瑰女王放了出來。另一方面炒麵麵包人，巧遇果Jam叔叔一行人。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌之綻放 · 鼎級笑容粵
programme.desc: 黃竹坑站有新盤入伙，驗樓師指，浴室窗邊沒做好防水，冷氣機底也可能積水，如何解決？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵 及 香港高昇基金呈獻：港好五年規劃粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 賽馬會智啟潛能學習計劃呈獻：「特」適其適粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 網上最近瘋傳的一段影片中，一名女童疑似被迫手提重物，令人擔憂涉及虐兒。為了探查真相，攝製隊嘗試登門了解。再有觀眾「報東張」，憶述自己亦疑似遇上假扮富人、訛稱遺失錢包借錢騙財的男子，幸她機警力保不失。另一名事主亦曾借錢予該騙子，卻能成功追回款項，詳情如何？新劇《驅魔速遞》日前舉行煞科飯局，陳曉華、周嘉洛等一眾演員相處融洽，對拍攝結束大感不捨。另會帶來可改善肌膚問題的美容資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#42粵
programme.desc: 嘉驄出埠寫生，唐芯則忙於籌備上莊，未能回家吃飯；萬里不想與嘉冰獨處，亦刻意不回家吃飯。嘉冰看穿其心事，遂找程祥劍幫忙處理家事，邀他翌日共進晚餐，安多勳亦一同前來。四人本來相處融洽，惟兩母女仍因小事爭執。其後，嘉冰雨夜為萬里送傘，卻發現她寧願冒雨回家，也不願接受她的好意。萬里後來出水痘發燒，向嘉冰道出埋藏多年的心結，指嘉冰當年只顧照料出水痘的弟弟而忽略了她。嘉冰獨自悉心照顧萬里，二人關係迎來轉機……

programme.title: 死有對証#23粵PG
programme.desc: 芷昕偶然發現重要線索，懷疑信基骸骨案的真兇另有其人。馮瑜極力遊說柏宇與佩嘉結婚並移民加拿大，柏宇懷疑馮瑜有事隱瞞，跟蹤後得知馮瑜一直被繼子甘世宏勒索。在柏宇追問下，馮瑜只好坦白……柏宇私下找世宏理論，大受打擊。翌日，警方接報一名男子暴屍橫巷，死者竟是世宏。柏宇相約佩嘉一同吃早餐，心中似已有所決定……

programme.title: 醫生，你有病？粵
programme.desc: 畫國畫、打網球、做手術，都靠同一雙手，但醫生都會有職業病？中大醫學院院長趙偉仁不單自醫，更是自己家庭的醫生，究竟是得心應手，還是相當棘手？醫學院沒教的一課，如何由「至親離世」來補上？

programme.title: 百花殺#25粵普PG
programme.desc: 青姝婢女誣陷華雍，被汐和掌摑。長卿代皇上臨朝，面對大臣逼殺汐和之聲，力排眾議，以貪污實證要挾大臣，宣佈迎娶汐和。遭長卿軟禁的汐和借去古寺祈福暗渡陳倉。皇上病重，賜名太孫並立儲，榮貴妃帶人逼宮搶奪詔書…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之綻放 · 鼎級笑容粵
老婆大人#3粵
programme.desc: 亞基向通叔訛稱國光有外遇激怒希敏，才令其三代同堂夢碎。國光被希敏趕出家門，幸彥祖大哭救了他。智雄接手天娜和志誠案，指亞基訂定的婚前協議書無效，但天娜偷竊罪也不成立。昕昕同情撿垃圾被檢控的婆婆，被希敏責罵感情用事不適合當主控官，委屈落淚。希敏細訴自已立志當法官往事，讓昕昕明白其苦心。通叔逼國光跟情婦劃清界線，亞基只好訛稱昕昕是情婦；通叔贈金項給昕昕作分手費。昕昕以為通叔要賄賂她，致電希敏及廉正公署。

programme.desc: 網上最近瘋傳的一段影片中，一名女童疑似被迫手提重物，令人擔憂涉及虐兒。為了探查真相，攝製隊嘗試登門了解。再有觀眾「報東張」，憶述自己亦疑似遇上假扮富人、訛稱遺失錢包借錢騙財的男子，幸她機警力保不失。另一名事主亦曾借錢予該騙子，卻能成功追回款項，詳情如何？新劇《驅魔速遞》日前舉行煞科飯局，陳曉華、周嘉洛等一眾演員相處融洽，對拍攝結束大感不捨。另會帶來可改善肌膚問題的美容資訊。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 心絞痛揭示心臟健康問題，不但形容胸口出現的「痛」，也可表現為「悶」或「壓着」，其常見原因是冠狀動脈血管收窄或閉塞。心臟科醫生提醒，痛楚或會擴散至身體不同部位，不容忽視。腎科專科醫生指腎功能開始下降時，通常並無明顯症狀，如持續有蛋白尿就是腎臟受損的早期警號！檢查腎病有何指標？醫生細述慢性腎病的高危因素，糖尿病正是其一，而腎病亦有可能影響心血管健康？「睇餸食飯」，李安生示範「薑蓉蔥油帶子蟹肉意粉」。

programme.title: 不老傳說粵
programme.desc: 盧敏儀個性天真活潑，由電視節目主持搖身變為執業大律師，形象與身分縱然大有不同，唯獨一顆赤子之心始終不變。當年敏儀曾為大型節目作高難度表演，精彩場面令人難忘。事隔多年，她依然身手矯健，箇中有何秘訣？她並即席展示日子有功的鍛練絕活。敏儀享受工作，並將事務所視為另一個家。不過，律師終日面對工作壓力，敏儀幸有丈夫相伴驅除煩惱，二人細說恩愛如昔的心得。另外，梓峰、芷菁同往動植物公園，跟可愛動物共享寫意時光。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#5粵PG
programme.desc: 牧師馬拉高出現於優富超市，利亞以為龍豹向拉高洩露了他的行蹤。拉高救炳哥一命而廉價租下拳館開教會。秋水得悉女性生育後或有助醫治敏感症，便着手籌備郭寶與靜雯的婚禮。靜雯被逼與郭寶親吻，卻因此當眾出醜……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#201粵
programme.desc: 亨與麗拍拖後愛上到處享受人生，又發現養育下一代需花費巨額金錢。亨一心想賺多些錢，為與麗的未來作出準備，更欲為瑜珈中心開設分店。本來，麗對亨的舉動也心存讚賞，但亨因過分投入搵錢大計而冷落麗。

programme.title: 玉樓春#15粵普PG
programme.desc: 玉樓被強盜綁架，少春隻身赴會贖人，用巧計救出玉樓。玉樓求得皇上賜婚。孫遜私下約見少春，被她的言行打動，不再反對婚事。賈逢源模仿孫遜字跡偽造書信，告訴少春是孫遜害死其父。大婚日孫遜喝下少春敬的茶後昏迷。

programme.title: Sunday好戲王粵PG
programme.desc: 「阿姐」汪明荃華麗駕臨，擔任「星級」評判，就着嘉賓藝員唐詩詠、沈震軒、何遠東、楊秀惠的「鬥戲」發揮，評選各個回合的贏家。究竟四位「好戲王」怎樣互拼演技兼發放「笑彈」？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#202粵
programme.desc: 悅發現「契姐」朱莉亞被麵檔老闆娘項太怒罵，指責她「破壞別人家庭幸福」。悅以為她做了第三者，強拉朱離開之餘，更勸她放棄。翌日悅欲帶朱購物時，她們又再碰到麵檔老闆一家，悅終發現，原來是自己會錯意。

programme.title: 玉樓春#16粵普PG
programme.desc: 抓到欲殺孫遜的賊人，少春想到從買兇錢財入手找出幕後真兇。映雪生疑，問逢源是否與買兇之事相關，逢源否認，但隨後便通知梁京冠並設法脫身。孫父、孫母盛讚少春聰慧，鳳翹眼紅，欲耍手段讓少春出醜，卻被少春破解。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
今個夏天食平D粵
programme.desc: 購入本土手打烏冬，以昆布等材料調出開胃醬汁，享用日式「冷烏冬」。六號自製「西瓜凍湯」，能得肥媽讚賞嗎？品嚐「紫菜豆腐肉丸湯」時竟有吃下綿花雞的感覺？肥媽示範做法簡單的「白菜雞」及「尖椒豆乾炒牛柳絲」。

programme.title: 賽馬會智啟潛能學習計劃呈獻：「特」適其適粵
流行都市粵
programme.desc: 鼻瘜肉被歸類為慢性鼻竇炎之一，鼻塞、睡眠窒息、嗅覺受損等是常見病徵。耳鼻喉科醫生指，若症狀持續，會對患者的日常生活造成困擾。醫生亦帶來不同診治方案，如藥物療效欠理想，患者或需考慮接受內窺鏡切除手術。香港展能節的宗旨是為殘疾及有特殊教育需要的人士，提供展示才能的平台。舉辦團體的代表介紹這個活動，同來的獲獎者分享參加原因與感受，盼藉自身經歷，鼓勵同路人。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨示範「日式吉列免治牛肉餅」。

programme.title: 不老傳說粵
programme.desc: 歌劇能夠陶冶性情、淨化心靈，著名男高音莫華倫不但以歌劇為伴，更將唱歌化為長青養生之道。過往數十年，莫華倫把歌劇文化帶到亞洲，同時向世界宏揚中國文化。雖然擁有歌唱天分，但他曾替自己設下三十歲的事業發展界線，原因何在？莫華倫為了保養天賦嗓子，作息定時，而練習歌劇竟是鍛練心肺與肌肉的有益運動？前身為中區警署及域多利監獄的「大館」，經活化後成為鬧市中的藝術展覽空間，「菁峰生活」引領觀眾感受當中藝文氣息。

programme.title: AXA 安盛呈獻 :歲歲無憂粵
programme.desc: 三位「星級」嘉賓黎耀祥、陳自瑤、張馳豪分別代表「樂齡族」、「夾心世代」與「年輕專業人士」，各人受訪細談處於現時的人生階段，對醫療保障的不同需要。究竟大家可如何做到「歲歲無憂」？

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#6粵
programme.desc: 秋水強行到保健中心拉靜雯離去。靜雯請拉高光顧，被誤會是妓女。秋水為照顧女兒，在保健中心樓上開議員辦事處。尤田被追債時偶遇林雪，一碰即愛上。追數公司老闆鼎爺收購了音樂公司，欠債者林雪自行找上門來……

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小玉夢想自己能飛上天，有天她看見小孩子的氣球飛走，靈機一觸想到可以用氣球把自己吊上空中。小丸子在家中發現彩票，核對後證實中了一萬円獎金，櫻家為此舉行家庭會議，商討如果處置該筆獎金。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 透過運動提升靈活度與柔軟度，有助減少受傷風險，一於「WORKOUT 2GETHER」。雙腳張開做「側弓箭步」，可伸展大腿內側的筋。單膝跪下，臀部前移至前腳膝蓋過腳尖，繼續拉筋。保持平板支撐姿勢，單腳踏前，再將另一隻腳踢向前，也考驗到協調能力。第二節「單邊及平衡力訓練」會利用水樽作負重工具，在單膝跪下或雙腳打開的動作下，單手握樽向上舉。坐下做出像美人魚的姿勢，舉起單手並重複抬臀，講究平衡力與專注度。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 由富良野策劃的公主感謝節，現正進入付諸實現的階段。富良野不僅獲得愛麗絲族的協助，還在阿堇穿針引線下，成功說服阿燎等人在當天舉行演唱會。為了這個演唱會，奈津編寫了一首新歌，還帶著新歌找上風花姊妹……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
programme.desc: 政府由1991年開始，將大學學費與成本掛鈎，1998年一年學費要44500元，差不多是1991年學費的四倍半，相較七年間的通脹累積增幅高很多，不少大學生要靠兼職來應付學費及生活費，新聞掏寶和大家重溫1998年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵 及 香港高昇基金呈獻：港好五年規劃粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
宏利保險呈獻：灣區零距離粵
賽馬會智啟潛能學習計劃呈獻：「特」適其適粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#43粵
programme.desc: 唐芯眼見大學同學出雙入對，也開始憧憬戀愛。唐芯邂逅不同學系的系草Aska後怦然心動，遂設法接近對方，卻屢遇行事冒失的男生Oscar而阻滯重重。另一方面，金剛欲為朋友介紹對象時，惟獨對唐芯視而不見，楊光等人點破箇中原因，唐芯遂嘗試作出改變，以全新形象示人。唐芯終於結識Aska，並設法博取好感。另一方面，萬里發現唐芯與Aska來往而大感緊張，擔心她會受騙；後來更在唐芯的袋內有所發現，令她大為震驚……

programme.title: 死有對証#24粵PG
programme.desc: 根據公關小姐Anita的口供，證實世宏死前見過柏宇。柏宇成為嫌疑犯，被淑嫻等人緝捕，佩嘉擔心不已。柏宇打算偕馮瑜潛逃加拿大卻不果，二人獲護老院花王孔國全帶到其舅父的村屋躲避。重案組尋獲證物，揭露Anita口供作假。國全告訴柏宇關於佩嘉來過護老院一事後，柏宇向馮瑜訛稱要赴約尋求逃離香港的方法，其實是約了佩嘉見面。其後，佩嘉被發現伏屍廢屋外，林琛到場作初步檢驗。芷昕得知消息後，悲痛地走進殮房冷藏室……

programme.title: 醫生，你有病？粵
programme.desc: 狀元和醫科已劃上等號，但十優狀元余思遠的醫科之路有點曲折，未駐院，先住院，成為活生生的教材，心胸有病醫得好，心結要解如何是好？貴為微創手術先驅，外科名醫嚴秉泉竟然遇上柏金遜症。救人無數的手也會顫抖，當妙手不妙，被迫放下手術刀，提早退休，究竟路在何方？

programme.title: 百花殺#26粵普PG
programme.desc: 榮貴妃包圍王宮，阻擋汐和離開，同時把朝中重臣都軟禁在偏殿，脅逼汐和交出詔書。聞溪得到步家令牌，準備調兵前往京城，但原來她是想協助逼宮…長卿準備大開殺戒之際，殿外出現信號，代表支援汐和的人馬已包圍宮殿…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
老婆大人#4粵
programme.desc: 通叔患有血糖高及痛風症等疾病，希敏禁止他吃不當食物，通叔又得知希敏不懂做家務及帶小孩，勃然大怒。希敏徹夜獨力照顧彥祖，筋疲力竭。智雄休假，看到希敏帶彥祖返法院，請纓替她照顧彥祖，期間遇見搭訕的少女。惠娟被國光急召返港幫忙照顧彥祖，勸希敏珍惜國光。國光與希敏和好如初。智雄赫聞搭訕少女竟是國光之二妹寶怡，通叔強拉寶怡返家禁足，希敏阻止。國光提出讓寶怡暫居其家，無意中發現寶怡被美國政府驅逐出境。

programme.desc: 從中醫學角度，咳嗽未必單純由肺部引起，季節轉變亦是常見成因，且四季的咳嗽症狀各有不同。中醫師因應四季咳嗽介紹舒緩湯水，並示範穴位按壓的保健手法。禁毒領袖學院的成立目標，是提升青少年的公民意識，將無毒訊息帶入校園。學院代表細說課程如何講解毒品的禍害、培養學員的領袖才能。同來的領袖學員亦分享入學的契機，以及參加課程的深刻點滴。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie師傅示範一道惹味家常菜「荷芹鮮沙薑雞」。

programme.title: 不老傳說粵
programme.desc: 馬詩慧喜歡吃甜品，不愛應酬，作風我行我素，以行動打破大眾對模特兒的固有印象。「貪靚」心態是詩慧保持容光煥發的動力，近年更認識到運動的重要，她與好友黃佩霞一起暢談瑜伽的益處。詩慧偕同兩女一子製作溫馨蛋糕，過程卻不乏鬥嘴場面，莫非吵鬧是維繫親情的獨門偏方？期間兒子還透露父親王敏德的金句，道出父母恩愛逾廿載的真諦。適時放開、適時保留，主持梓峰、芷菁分別藉着網上購物、收藏古著，尋求身心舒泰，有何見解？

programme.title: 語你同行三十載粵
programme.desc: 「深耕三十載 ，語你譜新篇」，教育局、語文教育及研究常務委員會(語常會)三十年來，致力協助在香港推動兩文三語。節目由星級藝員梁凱晴(Carina)、焦浩軒、語常會學生語文大使Anisah Hussain擔綱演出，述說當局如何透過政策藍圖、撥款、教學支援、多元化活動等各方面，讓本港市民，尤其是中小學生提升語文水平，進一步掌握兩文三語的運用。

櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子、爺爺、小玉和小杉一起參加法國菜班，法國菜雖然美味，但小丸子對吃的興趣遠勝於烹調過程。爺爺出門忘記帶這帶那，為了挽回小丸子的信心，他毅然購入釣魚背心，貪其口袋夠多可放各種東西。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 新環節「童Ai畫出界」，由主持姐姐引領小朋友暢玩「故事接龍」。大家一同發揮天馬行空的創意與想像力，每人一句接力創作，再交由AI生成有趣的動畫影片。首個故事圍繞魔法師在廚房忙碌工作，結尾卻變成魔法師與玩具們在舞台上開演唱會，過程中究竟發生了甚麼趣事？這回「開心SHARE」，小朋友分享「放學後回家會做的事」。有人會自己動手煮麵吃，勾起了主持姐姐滋味的下午茶回憶；也有小朋友透過五子棋與父母共建親子時光。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 眾人籌備多時，公主感謝節終於開幕。不僅是阿源一行，阿源在愛麗絲比亞認識的女生也參與其中，開設攤位。與此同時，阿源們正在等候風花姊妹的答覆，希望大家能在奈津準備的舞台，一同歌唱。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.desc: 萬里向唐芯興師問罪，始知錯怪了她。唐芯氣結離去，賭氣邀約Aska看戲，卻在戲院巧遇金剛與漢娜。Aska臨時有事未能赴約，由宿舍室友代他交戲票給唐芯，而該室友原來是Oscar，他更主動提出與唐芯一同看戲，期間大獻殷勤。Oscar見唐芯對自己並不抗拒，竟以為她對自己有意思，遂有更進一步舉動……唐芯大驚，為求脫身，只好找金剛充當男友作擋箭牌，佯言邀約Aska只因與男友耍花槍，豈料這番話竟引發連串風波……

programme.title: 死有對証#25粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)芷昕看過佩嘉的冰冷屍體後，在家中獨自崩潰落淚，高俊發短訊關心問候芷昕，卻得不到回覆。芷昕希望親自替佩嘉解剖，卻遭林琛拒絕，文琪幫忙勸喻林琛。芷昕終獲批准為佩嘉解剖，誓要尋找真相；同時，高俊找到關鍵線索……芷昕路祭佩嘉，恰巧碰見疑犯，獨自跟蹤對方卻陷入險境，高俊及時趕到現場。然而，芷昕遭疑犯手持利器挾持，高俊不忍看見芷昕受傷……

programme.title: 醫生，你有病？粵
programme.desc: 有醫生執照，但沒執業17年，台灣外科醫生蔡伯羌外表與常人無異，但行為像小孩，除了能醫不自醫，還不能自理，更忘記妻兒和自己，一切跟醫生過勞有關？ON CALL超過36小時，做到有病都不自知？

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們(完)
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 當你沉睡時(完)
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時(完)
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: Tuesday Club
programme.desc: Karin's world crumbles on her 40th anniversary when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. Seeking solace in a cooking class with renowned chef Henrik, she rediscovers her lifelong passions and learns that it is never too late to follow her dreams.

programme.title: Our River...Our Sky
programme.desc: Baghdad. Sara, a single mother and novelist, shocked into silence by the surrounding violence, has been unable to write. She and her neighbours struggle to resist the fragmentation of their world and renew a fragile sense of hope for a better future.

programme.title: A Far Shore
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Aoi is an underage mother struggling to make ends meet and dealing with her husband’s violent temper. After her husband loses his job, their continuous fights lead them to a social downfall.

programme.title: Murder in Sainte Baume
programme.desc: Carel has returned to his native Provence. With his ex-schoolmate, today head of the local police, he investigates the death of a man killed by dozens of bee stings. Soon they uncover a horrific case from the past, one that had shaken the whole village.

programme.title: Sleepless Night
programme.desc: A cop with a connection to the criminal underworld finds his secret life exposed when he and his partner are caught stealing cocaine from a powerful drug dealer, a move that puts his son's life in jeopardy.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: After the death of their father and mother, four siblings reunite to come to terms with the tragedy. They decide to participate in a hunting challenge which will determine their inheritance.

programme.title: Governance
programme.desc: Renzo, a brilliant and unscrupulous manager is forced to quit his position as general manager of an oil group after an investigation for corruption. Convinced that a young colleague betrayed him, he plots his revenge, but the situation gets out of hand.

programme.title: Diana's Wedding
programme.desc: Through the eyes of Diana, we witness the rollercoaster ride of both her parent’s and Irene’s marriages. To both girls, they have the worst parents in the world. But at the end of the day, which of the couples remain strong and which fall apart ?

programme.title: Ricky
programme.desc: When Katie, an ordinary woman, meets Paco, an ordinary man, something magical and miraculous happens: a love story. From this union will be born an extraordinary baby: Ricky.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Solar E-Glitch
programme.desc: After watching a solar eclipse, the team head into space to fix the biggest glitch yet!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Bike
programme.desc: Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Seesaw
programme.desc: Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help flip him off, but they still need to find one more friend.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Alamosaurus
programme.desc: Jen is carried away by a weather balloon and Andy sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to rescue her. Along the way, they meet the mighty Alamosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Sponge
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun playing with sponges, and so does Tincy the Spider in the Sing Song Forest - just watch out for those soapy bubbles!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Nature Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels can learn more about nature and wildlife if they follow five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, don't interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Dos and Don'ts Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess in the clubhouse, so Duggee explains that they need to think more carefully about what they are doing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Exercise Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels set off on a warm-up run together. The Squirrels are feeling sleepy, but they are told that a bit of exercise will wake them up!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Paddy Fields of China
programme.desc: The Go Jetters swing into action when Glitch uses real landmarks for his crazy golf course.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Nazca Lines, Peru
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to protect ancient artwork in Peru, when Glitch erases the Nazca Lines.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Thomas' Animal Friends
programme.desc: Thomas is asked to dress up as a monkey for a special event at the Animal Park, but all the other engines laugh at him. Luckily, Rebecca is on hand to offer some useful advice.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Balloon Barnacles
programme.desc: Sarah's hat goes on an adventure without her, on top of a balloon.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Basking Shark
programme.desc: Sarah is keen to adopt a sea creature, but doesn't get her first choice...

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Dinosaur
programme.desc: The children want to make a big dinosaur model so they can learn all about it. They make such a huge dinosaur that they want to take it to the museum to be shown as an exhibit.

programme.desc: Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies' man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the family's fortune.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: After a Japanese samurai is defeated and commits seppuku, ninja lord Chin leads his clan to China for revenge. They challenge martial arts leader Yuan with the deadly "Five Elements Ninja Formation", wiping out his unprepared disciples. The survivors must master the enemy's techniques to break the formation and avenge their comrades.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clan's hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary "Ri Hou". Instead, he finds "Ri Hou" dead and discovers the clan's founder, "Ye Di" Tie Yi, is his real father.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang's leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur. Her two colleagues die mangled in a lift accident and Inspector Wang is injured at his desk by a

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1977)
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma's pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels. Featuring two of the leading action stars of the era, Chen Kuen-tai and Lo Lie

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs III
programme.desc: Ming is transferred to do menial police work ten months after the murder of Yan, in 2004. Meanwhile, a new star, Wing, has emerged in the police force and Ming suspects he is also a mole sent by the triad. Determined to start anew, Ming must kill Wing while ensuring his own identity does not get exposed.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kong's drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK$100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora’s Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai…

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Make Room For Fifi

In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Fast &amp; Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Detonation
programme.desc: Cisco’s been kidnapped! The team scrambles to get him back, but Tony and Echo disagree on the best plan of action.

programme.title: Fast &amp; Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Meltdown
programme.desc: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Meltdown
programme.desc: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Hollywood Beginning
programme.desc: Three months after their battle in the arctic, the team is back in L.A. with one major change: they’ve been fired as Spy Racers! Most of the team is able to easily readjust to civilian life: Frostee is trying to get his license and Layla is a professional stunt driver in the biggest movie franchise in the world. But Tony can’t rest; his gut is telling him that Dann is still out there and is plotting to destroy L.A. and he’ll stop at nothing to prove it.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - End of the Dragon Master
programme.desc: Po, the kids, and the new Panda Guardians must work together to defeat Jindiao once and for all, and get a visit from an unlikely source

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Journey to the East
programme.desc: Feeling a little bored with their new hero life, Po and the kids are excited to accept an important invitation to the Forbidden City. Meanwhile, there's a curious disturbance deep in Panda Village...

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Curse of the Monkey King
programme.desc: Po and the Kids take a shortcut to the boat bound for the Forbidden City, and are waylaid by a tricky monkey. Zhizhu informs Mayor Li of some distressing sounds coming from the Wellspring.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Dragons of the Undead
programme.desc: When Feather is taken by a group of what appear to be zombie dragons, Alex finds her inner hero and rescues her friend.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Downpour
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder train a new species of aggressive tidal dragons to help the other riders put out a forest fire threatening ICARIS.

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Eggs

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Pounder
programme.desc: Ty and the crew must protect the Flatirons from Pounder, a predatory Poundersaurolophus who marks his territory by hammering everything in sight

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Boots
